description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 设置 › 外观 › 悬停提示关掉后，截图与录屏里的图标也不再弹说明；带“i”的说明照常显示。权限不变。
notes.en: With Settings › Appearance › Hover tips off, the screenshot and recording windows stop popping up icon explanations too; the "i" notes still show. Permissions unchanged.
